content.summary: Runs custom GLSL fragment shaders for real-time image processing. Supports multiple inputs as sampler2D uniforms and custom uniforms via CHOP/DAT references.
warnings: Requires GLSL version matching your GPU driver.
Shader compilation errors appear in the node info DAT, not in the Python console.

parameters.name: glslversion
parameters.label: GLSL Version
parameters.description: GLSL language version for shader compilation

parameters.name: outputresolution
parameters.label: Output Resolution
parameters.description: Resolution mode (e.g. Use Input, Custom Resolution)
